success_criteria: Video length is between 35 and 45 seconds as specified
Target audience (prospective and current engineering students) perceives the lab as energetic and friendly
Key messages are clearly presented: students build working multi‑agent AI systems and learn by building, testing and improving
Call to action “Come and build with us” is displayed prominently before the end
Visuals and narration are in English and maintain a clear, energetic tone throughout
Disclosure line “Created with AI agents — LY Agentic AI Lab” appears on screen
No unsupported statistics or invented contact details appear
creative_direction: Fast‑paced, kinetic montage style with bright, high‑contrast colors and dynamic camera moves that follow students as they code, prototype hardware, and test agents. Quick cuts sync to an upbeat soundtrack, interspersed with on‑screen kinetic typography highlighting the key messages, all framed for vertical 9:16 viewing. The tone stays energetic, friendly, and clearly narrated to guide viewers through a day in the lab.
risk_notes: No specific visual assets or footage list provided – ensure appropriate stock or captured material is sourced
No explicit branding guidelines given – avoid adding any institutional logos or colors not confirmed in the brief
If no disclosure line template is supplied, verify exact wording and placement to meet compliance

cost_budget.cost_note: USD cost is 'unknown' unless LLM_PRICE_IN_PER_M / LLM_PRICE_OUT_PER_M are set; the budget is therefore enforced on calls and tokens.
